limitations: Whole-process comparisons do not isolate causal exception cost.
Notification groups include runtime notifications and rethrows, not distinct failed requests.
Logical lifetime/task completion does not establish native heap release.
Kestrel unfinished fault-control tasks remain separately tracked in issue 361.
Measurements apply only to the recorded source and loaded binary identities.

integration.scope: Performance evidence applies to the recorded measured source; newer combined integration needs separate correctness validation and has no new performance claim.
